## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, typecheck, build, tests)
- [ ] New or changed rules have a defect fixture **and** a clean fixture
- [ ] New violation codes have an explanation (`ctc.explain.v1`)
- [ ] No network calls added to the gate path
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under "Unreleased"
- [ ] Docs / README updated if behaviour or flags changed
